attacker_baseline_stake.meaning: attacker's baseline stake held before the boundary deposit, comparable to passive users
attacker_baseline_stake.checkpoint: before boundary deposit in epoch e

boundary_deposit_offset.meaning: offset of the boundary deposit time from epochTimestampEnd(e); report states it is 1 epoch time unit before epoch end

claim_target_prev_epoch.meaning: epoch targeted by claim logic in epoch e+1, equal to e

current_epoch_index.meaning: the epoch e in which the boundary deposit occurs and whose claim is targeted

attacker_claim_boosted.meaning: the epoch e claim by the boundary-timing attacker is boosted beyond what the same stake held for the epoch would earn
attacker_claim_boosted.checkpoint: epoch e+1 claim for epoch e

honest_user_share_before.meaning: honest users' share of epoch e emissions before the boundary-timing dilution
honest_user_share_before.checkpoint: before boundary deposit affects epoch e distribution

honest_user_share_after.meaning: honest users' share of epoch e emissions after the boundary-timing deposit dilutes the distribution
honest_user_share_after.checkpoint: after boundary-timing claim for epoch e

assumptions: The boundary deposit adds utilization using full msg.value as stated in a_boundary_deposit.
Honest users do not run the timing strategy and hold their positions across epoch e.
The claim in epoch e+1 targets epoch e per p_claim_targets_prev_epoch.

unresolved.description: Report does not give numeric reward amounts or the exact dilution magnitude for honest users, only that dilution occurs.
Report does not quantify the epoch boundary timestamp semantics beyond epochTimestampEnd(e) - 1.

limitations: The proportional fairness relation is expressed at the amount level comparing honest users' share before and after the boundary-timing deposit; exact reward formulas are not provided.
The plan formalizes only the honest_user_dilution impact; inflated_reward_capture and emissions_extraction_pressure are not covered here.
